verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel with published enrollment is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing documents system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers, or an enrollment path, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
